title: Wife, husband 71: left face drooping, slurred speech after lunch

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We're at 455 Noriega Street. It's my husband, he's 71.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: His face is drooping on the left side and his speech is all slurred, I can barely understand him.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is he awake and breathing normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he's awake, he's sitting at the kitchen table.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was he last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He was fine around 12:30, right after lunch. We were talking and he was totally normal.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does he take any blood thinners?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, just his blood pressure pills.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Don't give him anything to eat or drink.
